scope: Read-only TD core_data.daily_kline_v1; local catalog and trade calendar; public Baostock range responses. No Redis, TD writes, or core-data writes.

td.query: SELECT symbol FROM core_data.daily_kline_v1 WHERE ts = '<date>'

universe.selection: ArtifactCatalog.locate on most recent partition on or before each day
universe.predicate: str(trade_status) != '0'; missing values retained under literal predicate and reported
universe.unavailable: 103 early dates have no earlier partition; do not use a future universe

candidate_gap: Active universe minus TD symbol set; all 131 candidates have a prior TD row within this window. Pre-window history cannot be inferred where no earlier TD row is present.
plan: Pure build_gap_fill_plan using observed 120-session watermarks, no forced dates, default depth 10 and sensitivity depth 120; no claim for symbols absent from the window or historical days lacking universe.

baostock.selection: All 27 candidates; up to 30 highest missing counts then random seed 756 for remaining quota; no random picks were needed
baostock.spacing: at least 1.05 seconds after the prior completed call except timing_unspaced group
baostock.classification: status 1=true gap; no row or status 0=reasonable missing per card; other/error=UNKNOWN
baostock.timing: network client call durations exclude deliberate spacing; first 10 spaced sample calls versus same 10 symbols unspaced

limits: Universe status is the stored snapshot, not independently verified event-day status. 605258 on 2026-11-02 is excluded because that universe snapshot records status 0, despite the earlier Baostock evidence. Missing 103 daily denominators preclude a 120-day total.
